title: The Early Echo Primer
summary: A primer for the rare early-awakened soul that casts its first faint echo and learns to keep it steady.

title: A First Reading of the Cast Likeness
summary: A first reading for the newly formed soul on throwing a flat likeness of itself a few paces off and drawing eyes to it.

title: Primer of the Standing Shade
summary: A primer on planting a motionless shade before the body so that it takes the first soul-strike meant for the user.

title: The Quiet Double Course
summary: A course on keeping a double so still and plain that no soul-sense marks it as a double until it moves.

title: Notes on the Thin Semblance
summary: Short notes on a semblance drawn so thin that it costs the soul almost nothing and fades the moment it is struck.

title: The Drifting Effigy Lessons
summary: Lessons on sending an effigy to drift away from the body on a slow line of soul force and calling it back whole.
